minutes.headline: ZBA granted PSG Realty a special permit to rebuild its garage/contractor yard on Leominster Shirley Road
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard PSG Realty 225/229 LLC's request to re-grant a dimensional special permit (originally approved in 2021 but since expired) for a redesigned, larger garage building and site improvements at 225-229 Leominster Shirley Road. After the applicant's engineer walked through the revised plan, parking, water supply, and construction-phasing details, the board voted to grant the special permit subject to standard conditions, and no members of the public were present to comment.

what_happened.line: ZBA voted to grant PSG Realty a special permit to rebuild its garage and contractor yard on Leominster Shirley Road.
The new permit replaces one granted in 2021 that had since expired, covering a redesigned, larger garage building.
The board left the choice between extending the water main or relying on the fire cistern to be settled at the building-permit stage, without returning to the board.
No members of the public attended to comment on the project.

why_it_matters: A special permit re-grant lets a commercial contractor yard rebuild larger than before, which affects traffic, water demand, and site conditions on that stretch of Leominster Shirley Road.
Leaving the water-supply method to be worked out administratively means that detail escapes further public or board review before construction.
watch_next: The permit carries a two-year lapse condition and a standard appeal period before it becomes final.
